questions.q: Does completing this LTV Academy path automatically result in an Oracle certification?
options: Yes, LTV Academy issues the certification directly upon course completion
No - LTV Academy does not issue Oracle certifications; a real certification requires passing Oracle's own proctored exam through Oracle University
Yes, but only for the General Ledger module specifically
Certifications are issued automatically after six months of LTV Academy membership
questions.explain: This lesson states plainly that LTV Academy does not issue Oracle certifications. Earning one requires passing Oracle's own proctored exam directly.

questions.q: Why does the lesson note that Oracle has renamed some certification tiers (for example, from 'Foundations Associate' to 'Process Essentials Certified')?
options: To show that certification names and structure can change over time, and that a rename doesn't invalidate a credential already earned under the old name
To argue that Oracle certifications are worthless
To prove that Oracle never changes its certification program
To recommend avoiding Oracle certifications altogether
questions.explain: The example illustrates that certification naming and structure drift over time - a normal part of the program, not a reason to distrust it, and renames don't erase previously earned credentials.

questions.q: Why are Oracle Cloud Applications exam codes often versioned to a specific year?
options: Because Oracle Cloud Applications update continuously, so exam content is refreshed periodically to match the current state of the product
Because older exam codes are illegal to use
Because Oracle changes exam codes randomly with no connection to the product
Because exam codes are year-versioned only for marketing purposes
questions.explain: Unlike older, fixed-version on-premise software, Oracle Cloud Applications update continuously, so exam codes are refreshed to match current product content.

questions.q: Where should you check for the current, authoritative list of exams and prerequisites for a specific module?
options: A random forum post with no date on it
Whatever this lesson says, without further verification
Oracle University's own certification pages, and Oracle CertView once credentialed
A third-party study-guide site's claims, taken as final
questions.explain: Oracle University's certification pages and Oracle CertView are the authoritative sources; third-party sites should be treated as a starting point to verify against them, not the final word.

questions.q: What is described as a realistic first certification target for someone finishing this path?
options: The most senior-sounding credential available, regardless of fit
No certification at all, since none are ever useful
A certification in an unrelated Oracle product line
An implementation-level credential in the specific module (GL, AP, or AR) the person is strongest in and wants to work in
questions.explain: The lesson recommends targeting an implementation credential that matches the module and role the person is actually pursuing, rather than chasing a credential just because it sounds senior.
